items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix B: Illustrative Project List
items.description: Documents unfunded regional projects that could enter the metropolitan plan if resources become available, including Albuquerque-area roadway extensions, interchange reconstruction, transit, trails, and supporting implementation requirements.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative six-page PDF preserved without modification.
Reviewed project descriptions, preliminary costs, sponsorship and funding requirements, and federal illustrative-list context.
Retained because it records significant regional proposals omitted from the fiscally constrained project list.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix C: Projects of Regional Interest
items.description: Records the 2020 status of major regional proposals, including the Gibson extension, I-25 projects, Mesa del Sol interchanges, Atrisco Vista, Paseo del Volcan, and cross-river connections.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative three-page PDF preserved without modification.
Reviewed all named regional projects, status explanations, planning relationships, and implementation context.
Retained as a concise historical snapshot of longstanding Albuquerque metropolitan proposals.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix D: Financial Plan Detail
items.description: Details the revenue forecasts, maintenance and operations costs, capital funding, project expenditures, local sources, federal programs, transit assumptions, and fiscal-constraint calculation supporting Connections 2040.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative five-page PDF preserved without modification.
Report date March 5, 2020; reviewed fiscal-constraint summary and detailed federal, state, tribal, transit, private, and local projections.
Retained because it documents the financial assumptions behind the adopted regional project program.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix G: Recommended Pathways
items.description: Compiles regional implementation strategies for mobility, active transportation, economic connections, and resilience, including Complete Streets, road diets, safety audits, transit, connectivity, land use, freight, and climate adaptation.
items.provenance_status: official MRCOG MTP Archive and byte-identical MRCOG-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative seven-page PDF preserved without modification.
Reviewed the full member-agency pathway matrix and its relationship to the four Connections 2040 goals.
Retained as the plan's concise implementation-policy toolbox.

items.title: Connections 2040 Appendix I: Federal Performance Measures and FAST Act Report
